title: EvoGuard: Mitigating Degradation in Online Skill Evolution
why: EvoGuard guards online skill-library evolution: trains a pairwise skill selector on utility-labeled skill pools so new skills are adopted only when better, at single-forward-pass latency instead of costly held-out eval—central to safe skill-library self-evolution.
mechanism: Build skill pools via iterative agent runs; score skills on private tests; rejection-sample clear-utility pairs; train label-token logit selector; at deploy pick better skill in one forward pass vs adopt-every-update or full validation.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported (abs): vs adopt-every-new-skill — +11.0% ALFWorld, +5.9% ScienceWorld, +2.7% LiveCodeBench success.

title: The Harness Is the Model: Agent Scaffolding Changes a Fixed LLM's Compliance with Banking Conduct Rules, Unevenly Across Models
why: Controlled audit showing that swapping the agent harness (pipeline / ReAct / search-only policy / long memory / same-model reviewer) changes banking-conduct compliance with the LLM held fixed—up to 11.5pp within a model—and argues the validation unit is the model–harness pair. Harness-effect audit in-scope.
mechanism: Five harness scaffolds × four open-weight models on 156 pre-registered retail-bank cases; deterministic scoring from executed tool traces (violations vs over-refusals); measures within-model harness spread and model×harness interaction.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported (abs): pooled harness correct-case 87.3–92.1%; within-model spread up to 11.5pp (Cochran Q=25.1, p<0.001); same-model reviewer cuts violations 9.6%→6.4% without raising over-refusals; 26% of violations had denial-in-transcript (exploratory).
